parameters.name: BackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup set.

parameters.name: CrossRole
parameters.description:
The Resource Access Management (RAM) role of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the backup set belongs.

>  This parameter must be specified only when cross-account backup operations are performed.

parameters.name: CrossUid
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the backup set belongs.

>  This parameter must be specified only when cross-account backup operations are performed.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30** (default)
*   **50**
*   **100**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-backups --db-cluster-id am-bp18934i73vb50000 --backup-id 327320000 --start-time 2022-06-01T16:00Z --end-time 2022-06-02T16:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --cross-uid 1950000 --cross-role role-for-xxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
